source_documents.title: Advanced spectroscopy research of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer and molecular aggregation in a chosen 1,3,4-thiadiazole derivative in micellar systems

conditions_studied: micelles: Triton X-100 below and above CMC

reference_evidence_units.quote: NTBD displays only a single fluorescence emission in methanol but shows pronounced dual fluorescence in TX-100 micellar solutions
reference_evidence_units.subject: NTBD

reference_evidence_units.quote: This dual emission indicates that surfactant-driven aggregation strongly promotes ESIPT (aggregation-induced emission, AIE).
reference_evidence_units.subject: NTBD
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The intermolecular interaction behind the effect is not identified; the ESIPT assignment refers to the authors' earlier paper.
